title: DuplexLedger: Benchmarking Transactional Memory in Full-Duplex Speech Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.27581v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Full-duplex speech agents must update persistent memory while listening and speaking, yet it remains unclear which events should be stored, revised, or excluded. Existing benchmarks isolate interaction timing from memory outcomes, obscuring the state transitions behind a correct answer. We introduce DuplexLedger, a bilingual benchmark of 1,094 persistent sessions aligning four full-duplex scenarios with event-level Write/Update/Ignore/Retain supervision, explicit pre/post memory states, and 6,564 same-session questions and checks. Evaluating five full-duplex models reveals an interaction-memory gap: no system combines strong boundary control with coherent final-state memory, and the best final-state fact coverage is 2.01%. We propose ACT-Mem, an 8.92M-parameter sidecar comprising an event controller, a versioned transactional ledger, and a typed retriever coupled with a frozen MiniCPM-o 4.5 backbone. On 219 held-out sessions, ACT-Mem inc

translated_title: DuplexLedger：全双工语音智能体中事务性记忆的基准测试
translated_abstract: 全双工语音智能体必须在聆听和说话的同时更新持久记忆，然而哪些事件应当被存储、修改或排除仍不明确。现有基准将交互时机与记忆结果割裂开来，掩盖了正确答案背后的状态转换。我们提出 DuplexLedger，一个包含 1,094 个持久会话的双语基准，将四种全双工场景与事件级的写入/更新/忽略/保留监督、显式的前后记忆状态以及 6,564 个同会话问题和检查项对齐。对五个全双工模型的评估揭示了一种“交互-记忆差距”：没有任何系统能同时具备强边界控制和连贯的最终状态记忆，最佳最终状态事实覆盖率仅为 2.01%。我们提出 ACT-Mem，一个 8.92M 参数的侧挂模块，由事件控制器、版本化事务账本和类型化检索器组成，并与冻结的 MiniCPM-o 4.5 骨干网络耦合。在 219 个保留会话上，ACT-Mem（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出双语基准 DuplexLedger，首次将全双工语音交互与事件级记忆事务监督对齐，揭示了现有模型的“交互-记忆差距”，并配套提出轻量级侧挂模块 ACT-Mem 以提升持久记忆管理能力。
en_tdlr: DuplexLedger, a bilingual benchmark aligning full-duplex speech interaction with event-level Write/Update/Ignore/Retain memory supervision, reveals an interaction-memory gap in existing models and is paired with a lightweight sidecar module ACT-Mem for transactional persistent memory management.
